technology_name: SOLAR-POWERED ROTATING FLASK OSCILLATORY FLOW REACTOR FOR BIODIESEL PRODUCTION
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Conventional continuous-flow biodiesel synthesis lines require high external grid power footprints for constant mechanical mechanical stirring loops, raising overall carbon generation levels.
description: A green, highly efficient bio-reactor design featuring a solar-powered rotating flask framework operating via an automatic zero-grid-electricity oscillatory flow mechanism to achieve vigorous mixing frequencies.
applications: Decentralized commercial biodiesel manufacturing plants, off-grid agricultural fuel generation grids, sustainable community energy hubs, and organic chemical processing loops.
secondary_sector: Advanced Materials & Chemical, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
